title: Lab size, from everyone alone to one lab of everyone, on a graph where deeper ideas are harder by 3 bits per level
html:
Lab size, from everyone alone to one lab of everyone, on a graph where deeper ideas are harder by 3 bits per level

Question: On a graph where deeper ideas are harder by 3 bits per level, with 24 agents in labs of 1 to 24 that share inside the lab, how much money does the field need, against OSO across the whole field?

Answer: At budgets 8–16: best Traditional (α = 1, β = 0), alone (7 measures). At budgets 32–64: best OSO (α = 0.2, β = 1). Against traditional, clearly better on hardest level, knowledge found (bits) and knowledge per unit of money; clearly worse on waste; no clear difference on targets solved, bounty value and ROI. At budgets 128–256: best OSO (α = 0.2, β = 1). Against traditional, clearly better on hardest level, knowledge found (bits) and knowledge per unit of money; no clear difference on targets solved, bounty value, ROI and waste. At budgets 512–1024: best OSO (α = 0.2, β = 1). Against traditional, clearly better on hardest level, targets solved, bounty value, ROI, knowledge found (bits), knowledge per unit of money and waste. At budget 2048: best Labs of 24 (one lab of everyone). Against traditional, clearly better on hardest level, targets solved, bounty value, ROI, knowledge found (bits), knowledge per unit of money and waste. At budgets 4096–8192: best OSO (α = 0.2, β = 1). Against traditional, clearly better on hardest level, targets solved, bounty value, ROI, knowledge found (bits), knowledge per unit of money, money to the main level and waste. At budget 16384: best OSO (α = 0.2, β = 1). Against traditional, clearly better on ROI, knowledge per unit of money, money to the main level and waste; no clear difference on hardest level, targets solved, bounty value and knowledge found (bits). At budget 32768: best Labs of 24 (one lab of everyone). Against traditional, clearly better on ROI, knowledge per unit of money, money to the main level and waste; no clear difference on hardest level, targets solved, bounty value and knowledge found (bits). At budget 65536: best OSO (α = 0.2, β = 1). Against traditional, clearly better on ROI, knowledge found (bits), knowledge per unit of money, money to the main level and waste; no clear difference on hardest level, targets solved and bounty value. (Compared at each budget; 8 measures, a clear difference is more than 2.7 standard errors.)
